Maya L: FYI ran into a reconciliation mismatch when a streaming request crossed regions. invoice showed duplicated token counts. :frowning:
Samir: can you paste a short repro? which ids differ?
Maya L: short repro: client starts chat (eu-west), heavy fanout routes part of the work to us-east. ingress edges stamp different fingerprints. we end up with two usage events that look like separate sessions to the ledger.
Priya: hmm. we currently treat prefix_fingerprint as canonical for dedupe. that's per-edge. Not ideal for multi-shard flows.
Tom B: could we lean on x-request-id (or a propagated request_id) as the canonical session id? tracing already uses it.
Samir: in theory yes. in practice a few connectors/old sidecars don't copy trace headers into metering events.
Maya L: proposal: introduce a provenance_envelope at ingest that groups component usage and emits a canonical_envelope_id. example payload we can add to the ingest stream:
```
{
  "canonical_envelope_id": "env_abc123",
  "components": [
    {"provider": "eu-west", "tokens": 120, "fingerprint": "fp_eu_1"},
    {"provider": "us-east", "tokens": 80, "fingerprint": "fp_us_7"}
  ],
  "request_id": "req-xyz-000"
}
```
Samir: nice. billing should consume the envelope and expand into per-provider ledger rows while the invoice-level metadata (tenant_jurisdiction, tax_rate) comes from tenant profile, not event.region.
Priya: important: keep a single invoice jurisdiction field. the tax calc should run at finalize using tenant.billing_profile.jurisdiction. otherwise finance will cry.
Tom B: edge case: late-arriving components (streaming continues after the invoice closes). we need a recon job that patches ledger rows and emits audit deltas.
Maya L: agreed. recon job sketch: compact-reconciler listens for component updates, re-aggregates envelope totals, computes delta = new_total - recorded_total, writes compensation rows and emits audit event `{envelope_id, reconciled: true, delta_tokens}`.
Samir: add a watermark and backfill window for late arrivals; default 24h with opt-in longer windows for heavy streaming tenants.
Priya: also expose a metric `envelope_reconciliations` and a counter `jurisdiction_mismatch_events` so finance and ops can monitor drift.
Tom B: implement plan: 1) quick patch: copy request_id into metering.event when present. 2) add optional `canonical_envelope_id` header at edge when fanout detected. 3) small adapter for legacy connectors that maps local `prefix_fingerprint` -> envelope.component.fingerprint so we can converge data.
Maya L: I'll draft the envelope schema RFC and include examples and reconciliation semantics. Samir, can you own the reconciler job? Priya, can you update billing finalize rule to prefer tenant profile for tax jurisdiction?
Samir: happy to own the job. will spike a prototype converting a couple of legacy connectors and open a PR for request_id propagation.
Priya: will draft billing rules and coordinate with finance.
MeteringBot: deploy-bot: metering-ingest v2 rolled to canary (eu-west) @ 2026-03-21T15:40:00Z :rocket:
Maya L: cool. let's sync tomorrow 10am PT to review RFC and recon SLAs. :thumbsup:
